claim_id: haidt-core-claims-verbatim (a: 2022 Senate testimony / b: anxiousgeneration.com norms / c: book "single largest reason")
corrections: (c) 关键口径:待验表述把书里的第一人称限定词删掉了。修正前(待验):"Great Rewiring...single largest reason for the tidal wave of adolescent mental illness",读起来像平铺直叙的断言。修正后(书内原句,p.44 逐字):"This Great Rewiring of Childhood, I argue, is the single largest reason for the tidal wave of adolescent mental illness that began in the early 2010s." —— 必须补回 "I argue"(作者自陈的论证立场,非既定事实)与时间窗 "that began in the early 2010s"。

(c) 出处定位修正。修正前:只问"是否书内原文(或仅宣传材料)"。修正后:确认为书内原文,非宣传材料——Google Books 对 ISBN 9780593655030 的全文检索命中 Page 44;p.44 位于第 1 章 The Surge of Suffering(章首 p.25)与第 2 章 What Children Need to Do in Childhood(章首 p.53)之间,即在第 1 章内,不在 Introduction。

(b) 时效与出处范围修正。修正前:"anxiousgeneration.com 官网逐字"四条 norms(含 "Phone-free schools, from bell to bell")。修正后:该措辞是 2026-07-27 当日实时官网的措辞,须标注取用日期。2024-05-02 Wayback 快照的同一栏目标题为 "The Four New Norms",且第 3 条只作 "Phone-free schools",无 "from bell to bell";第 4 条结尾带句号。措辞是后期改的,不是自 2024 年以来的稳定表述。

(b) 别把网站四条 norms 当成书里的四条。修正前:易被读成书与官网同一套措辞。修正后:书内 p.290 称之为 "four foundational reforms",第 4 条书内作 "Far more unsupervised play and childhood independence",与官网 "More independence, free play, and responsibility in the real world" 措辞不同;书内 "Phone-free schools" 出现在 p.239,检索不到 "from bell to bell"。前两条 "No smartphones before high school" / "No social media before 16" 书内 p.15 命中,与官网一致。
(a) 极小的一处补注(不影响引语成立):证词正文用连字符 "eye-witness",但同文件 2.8 节小标题作 "eyewitness"(无连字符)。待验表述引的是正文句,连字符正确。另证词标题为 "...Social Media is a Major Contributing Cause",比正文 "a major cause" 措辞更收敛,引用时勿混用。
evidence_notes: (a) 一手 PDF 直取并逐字比对成立。https://www.judiciary.senate.gov/imo/media/doc/Haidt%20Testimony.pdf 下载后经 pdftotext 提取(12 页)。抬头:"Teen Mental Health Is Plummeting, and Social Media is a Major Contributing Cause / Testimony of Jonathan Haidt / Professor of Ethical Leadership, New York University – Stern School of Business / Before the Senate Judiciary Committee, Subcommittee on Technology, Privacy, and the Law / May 4, 2022" —— 日期、委员会、URL 全部与待验表述一致。

(a) 原文位于 PART 3 开头(PDF 第 11 页),逐字为:"Correlational, experimental, and eye-witness testimony points to social media as a major cause of the crisis. I do not believe that social media is the only cause of the crisis, but there is no alternative hypothesis that can explain the suddenness, enormity, and international similarity that I laid out in part 1 of this document." 待验表述的两句连贯性、Oxford 逗号("suddenness, enormity, and international similarity")、省略号截断位置均正确。

(a) 斜体核实通过:用 pdftohtml -i 提取带标记文本,得 "social media is the only cause",证实 only 在原件中确为斜体,待验表述用 *only* 标注属实。(注:多数二手转述如 Deseret News 漏掉了 Oxford 逗号,作 "suddenness, enormity and international similarity"——以一手 PDF 为准。)

(b) 官网原始 HTML 直取(curl 抓 https://www.anxiousgeneration.com/ ,140,079 字节,正则去标签后比对),五条全部逐字命中:"In 2012, childhood shifted from play and independence to screens and social media."(位于 The Problem 栏目);以及 "The Four Norms to Roll Back the Phone-Based Childhood: 1 No smartphones before high school 2 No social media before 16 3 Phone-free schools, from bell to bell 4 More independence, free play, and responsibility in the real world"。
(b) 同页 FAQ(Our Approach)另有一处并列表述,第 3 条只写 "Phone-free schools",无 "from bell to bell"。同一页面内两处措辞不一致——引用时应指明取自 "The Four Norms" 主栏目。

(c) 书内命中经过对照实验证伪控制,证据力强。对 Google Books volume n9fDEAAAQBAJ(ISBN 9780593655030)做站内精确短语检索:完整候选句、"This Great Rewiring of Childhood, I argue, is the single largest reason"、"single largest reason for the tidal wave of adolescent mental illness"、"tidal wave of adolescent mental illness that began in the early 2010s" 四种查询全部命中且一致定位 Page 44。

(c) 三条故意改写的对照查询全部零命中,排除了模糊匹配假阳性:"is the single largest cause of the tidal wave..."(reason→cause)、"...that began in the early 2000s"(2010s→2000s)、以及一条无关改写句。说明检索为逐字匹配,故 p.44 的措辞即为待验句式(含 "I argue" 与 "early 2010s")。

(c) 版本信息经出版方页面核实:Penguin Press,2024-03-26,400 页,ISBN 9780593655030,副标题 "How the Great Rewiring of Childhood Is Causing an Epidemic of Mental Illness"(https://www.penguinrandomhouse.com/books/729231/the-anxious-generation-by-jonathan-haidt/)。注意英国版副标题为 "...Caused an Epidemic..."(过去时),两版副标题不同,勿混引。
利益相关性检查:(a) 与 (b) 两个来源均为 Haidt 本人/其倡议组织自撰——证词是其本人的政策倡导文件,anxiousgeneration.com 为其运动官网(据站内 FAQ 挂靠 NYU Stern、由慈善捐助全额资助)。三条论断都是"Haidt 说了什么"的表述性论断,自撰来源足以证实措辞;但不可当作其因果主张本身的独立证据。

反证检索备注:证词中 "there is no alternative hypothesis" 这一断言本身在学界存在实质争议(Candice Odgers 2024 年在 Nature 的书评明确称 Haidt 混淆相关与因果、且"无证据"支持重塑大脑说,Haidt 已公开反驳;Przybylski、Ferguson 等亦持异议)。但这不影响 (a) 的判定——待验论断只主张该逐字句存在于证词中,此点成立。
unresolved: p.44 的页面影像未能直接目视。Google Books 返回 "Restricted Page"(受版权预览限制),故书内措辞是靠"精确短语命中 + 三条改写对照零命中"间接锁定,而非阅读原页。若需法务级引用,建议以纸质版/正版电子版 p.44 复核一次。
无法百分之百断定 "from bell to bell" 与 "More independence, free play, and responsibility in the real world" 完全不在书中——Google Books 的站内索引对受限预览书目可能不完整,零命中是强提示但非证明。
anxiousgeneration.com 上 "In 2012, childhood shifted..." 一句的最早出现时间未能确定。2024-05-02 的 Wayback 快照去标签后仅 3,982 字符(该版页面内容少且可能依赖 JS 渲染),因此该句在 2024 年版中"未出现"不能作为可靠结论。
书籍章节页码边界(第 1 章 p.25、第 2 章 p.53)取自站内检索命中页,未能与实体目录核对;p.44 归属第 1 章为据此推断,置信度高但非直接读取目录所得。

claim_id: haidt-core-claims-verbatim (a) Senate testimony / (b) anxiousgeneration.com / (c) "Great Rewiring...single largest reason"
corrections: (a) 无需修正,但需补足限定语与出处定位。修正前:笼统称「Haidt 2022-05-04 参议院证词含此句」。修正后:该句位于该 PDF 第 10 页(PART 3 开头第二段),文件标题为 “Teen Mental Health Is Plummeting, and Social Media is a Major Contributing Cause”,Testimony of Jonathan Haidt, Before the Senate Judiciary Committee, Subcommittee on Technology, Privacy, and the Law, May 4, 2022。逐字比对全中,含 only 的斜体(PDF 页面嵌有 Calibri-Italic 字体,渲染图确认 only 为斜体)。原文续接句为 “...that I laid out in part 1 of this document.”(part 1 小写),待验表述以省略号截断,未失真。

(b) 四条 norms 逐字成立,但需加限定语:修正前「官网四条 norms 逐字为 ...Phone-free schools, from bell to bell...」。修正后:该四条完整逐字表述出现在首页 “The Four Norms to Roll Back the Phone-Based Childhood” 版块;同页 FAQ「What changes do you recommend?」中第三条被简写为 “Phone-free schools”(无 “from bell to bell”)。引用时须指明取自 Four Norms 版块而非 FAQ。

(b) 2012 句逐字成立,但需修正其文本位置:修正前(隐含)该句为官网主张性标语。修正后:“In 2012, childhood shifted from play and independence to screens and social media.” 逐字出现在首页 FAQ 的「The Problem — What's happening with kids and social media/smartphones?」答案首句,后接 “Constant notifications, endless scrolling, and online comparison wire kids for anxiety, depression, attention fragmentation, self-harm, and more.”

(c) 该表述并非宣传材料:修正前「可能仅为宣传材料」。修正后:已核实 Penguin UK(9780241647660)与 Penguin Random House US(书号页 729231)两版官方书籍简介/护封文案均不含 “single largest reason” 或 “tidal wave of adolescent mental illness” 字样,故该句不是出版社文案;多方独立来源一致将其定位于书内第 1 章 “The Surge of Suffering”。

(c) 引语本身需补回被省略的对冲词与前句:修正前 “Great Rewiring...single largest reason for the tidal wave of adolescent mental illness”。修正后(据多源一致转录)完整为:“Between 2010 and 2015, the social lives of American teens moved largely onto smartphones with continuous access to social media, online video games, and other internet-based activities. This Great Rewiring of Childhood, I argue, is the single largest reason for the tidal wave of adolescent mental illness that began in the early 2010s.” 待验表述漏掉了 “I argue” 这一对冲限定,且主语是 “This Great Rewiring of Childhood”(特指 2010–2015 年社交生活迁移至智能手机这一过程),不是泛指的 Great Rewiring 全概念。

(c) 最重要的口径修正:不可把该句当作全书「中心论断」。修正前(隐含)该句代表 Haidt 全书核心主张。修正后:书中明确自我标注的中心主张在导论第 9 页,已在出版社官方样章 PDF 中逐字核到,为 “My central claim in this book is that these two trends—overprotection in the real world and underprotection in the virtual world—are the major reasons why children born after 1995 became the anxious generation.” 差异有三:(1) 是「两条趋势」(现实世界过度保护 + 虚拟世界保护不足),而非单一 Great Rewiring;(2) 用 “the major reasons”(复数、程度更弱),而非 “the single largest reason”;(3) 结果变量表述为 “became the anxious generation”,而非 “tidal wave of adolescent mental illness”。引用时应说明「书中有一处强表述(Ch.1)与一处更宽更弱的自述中心主张(导论 p.9)并存」。
(c) 年份口径提醒:该句结尾为 “began in the early 2010s”。检索过程中有二手摘要误作 “early 2000s”,属讹传,勿沿用。
evidence_notes: (a) 一手直核:下载 https://www.judiciary.senate.gov/imo/media/doc/Haidt%20Testimony.pdf (790.9KB, 12 页),pdftotext 抽取后原文第 10 页作:“The crisis emerged in the exact years when American teens were getting smart phones and becoming daily users of social media platforms such as Instagram. Correlational, experimental, and eye-witness testimony points to social media as a major cause of the crisis. I do not believe that social media is the only cause of the crisis, but there is no alternative hypothesis that can explain the suddenness, enormity, and international similarity that I laid out in part 1 of this document.” 与待验表述逐字一致。
(a) 斜体核验:pdffonts 显示第 10 页嵌入 ZYVGUU+Calibri-Italic;以 pdftoppm 130dpi 渲染该页并目视确认 “only” 确为斜体,支持待验表述中的 *only* 标记。

(a) 出处元数据核验(PDF 第 1 页):标题 “Teen Mental Health Is Plummeting, and Social Media is a Major Contributing Cause”;“Testimony of Jonathan Haidt, Professor of Ethical Leadership, New York University – Stern School of Business, Before the Senate Judiciary Committee, Subcommittee on Technology, Privacy, and the Law, May 4, 2022”。日期 2022-05-04 与待验一致。

(a) 上下文补充(可用于反驳「过度确定」质疑):同文件 2.1 节小标题自陈 “Correlational studies consistently show a link between heavy social media use and mood disorders, but the size of the relationship is disputed”,即 Haidt 本人在同一文件中承认效应量存争议。

(b) 一手直核(绕开摘要模型,curl 取 https://www.anxiousgeneration.com/ 原始 HTML 140,079 字节后剥标签):Four Norms 版块原文为 “The Four Norms to Roll Back the Phone-Based Childhood / 1 No smartphones before high school / 2 No social media before 16 / 3 Phone-free schools, from bell to bell / 4 More independence, free play, and responsibility in the real world”。四条逐字全中。
(b) 一手直核:同一 HTML 中 FAQ 段落原文 “In 2012, childhood shifted from play and independence to screens and social media.” 逐字全中。同 HTML 另一处 FAQ 将第三条简写为 “Phone-free schools”。
(b) 利益相关性提示:anxiousgeneration.com 自述 “The Anxious Generation Movement is a fiscally sponsored 501(c)(3) led by Jonathan Haidt”,即该站为 Haidt 本人领导的倡导组织官网,属当事方自述材料,可作「Haidt 主张为何」的一手证据,但不可作为主张真伪的独立证据。

(c) 出版社官方样章一手核验:https://cdn.penguin.co.uk/dam-assets/books/9780241647660/9780241647660-sample.pdf (40 页,含版权页 Copyrighted Material 水印,为正式书内排版),pdftotext 后第 9 页逐字作 “My central claim in this book is that these two trends—overprotection in the real world and underprotection in the virtual world—are the major reasons why children born after 1995 became the anxious generation.” 此为书中唯一自我标注的 central claim。
(c) 反证性核查:该 40 页官方样章覆盖导论(Growing Up on Mars, pp.1–17 区段)及第 1 章开头至约 p.31(止于 Figure 1.5 美国 10–14 岁自杀率图),全文 grep “largest” 零命中,故 “single largest reason” 一句不在 pp.1–31 范围内,与其位于第 1 章后半(约 pp.31–44)的定位不冲突。

(c) 排除「仅为宣传材料」假设:Penguin UK 版简介(经检索取得全文)与 Penguin Random House US 书页 https://www.penguinrandomhouse.com/books/729231/the-anxious-generation-by-jonathan-haidt/ 的官方简介均经核查,两者都不含 “single largest reason” 与 “tidal wave of adolescent mental illness”;US 简介只出现小写 “great rewiring of childhood” 并罗列多重机制。

(c) 二手但独立的三源互证(均指向书内 Ch.1 “The Surge of Suffering”):同行评议期刊书评 British Journal of General Practice 74(744):322, https://bjgp.org/content/74/744/322 (Richard Armitage) 以直接引语形式引用 “the single largest reason for the tidal wave of adolescent mental illness that began in the early 2010s”;读书笔记 https://stekel.org/the-anxious-generation 给出完整两句并标注 (Ch. 1: The Surge of Suffering);另一独立笔记 https://geyre.co.uk/2025/02/27/notes-from-the-anxious-generation-by-jonathan-haidt/ 给出同样两句(含多处拼写错误,属人工转录,恰说明与 stekel 非同源抄袭)。

(c) 反证/后续争议(与待验点无关但影响引用方式):Nature 书评 Candice Odgers, https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-024-00902-2 认为该书「大脑被重塑并导致精神疾病流行」的反复暗示缺乏科学支持;Nature 后续报道 https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-025-00991-7 亦述学界分歧。书评 https://benchugg.com/writing/anxious_generation/ 指出 Haidt 选择性呈现(强调 10–14 岁女孩自残 +189%,略过智能手机接触更多的 15–19 岁仅 +62%),并引 Ferguson 2025 元分析称因果效应的元分析证据「statistically no different than zero」。
unresolved: (c) 未能取得书内该句的一手影像/页码。Penguin 官方样章仅覆盖至约 p.31,该句落在样章之外;Google Books API 多次重试(含延时 20s/45s、更换 User-Agent 与 country 参数)持续返回 HTTP 429,books.google.com 网页版被反爬拦截;archive.org advancedsearch 对该书返回空结果,未找到可用的 search-inside 副本。故该句「确为书内原文」目前依据为 1 篇同行评议期刊书评 + 2 份独立读书笔记的一致转录,尚缺一手页面确证。
(c) 页码存疑:一次检索摘要称该句在 p.44,但该数字来自搜索引擎生成式摘要而非可核对的原始引注,未在任何一手或可验证二手来源中比对成功,故不予采信,亦不写入结论。
(c) 未核到该句在精装版 / 平装版 / Kindle 各版本间是否存在措辞或页码差异;若后续引用需精确页码,建议以纸质精装版 Ch.1 “The Surge of Suffering” 结尾段落实物比对。
(a)(b)(c) 均未检索到官方勘误(errata)或作者对上述三处表述的事后修正声明;仅检索到学界对实质主张的批评(见 evidence_notes),未发现文本层面的更正,故「无勘误」这一点属未能证否而非已证实。

corrections: (c) 引文口径 — 修正前:「Great Rewiring...single largest reason for the tidal wave of adolescent mental illness」(压缩式引用,且不确定是否为书内原文);修正后:书内原句为 “Between 2010 and 2015, the social lives of American teens moved largely onto smartphones with continuous access to social media, online video games, and other internet-based activities. This Great Rewiring of Childhood, I argue, is the single largest reason for the tidal wave of adolescent mental illness that began in the early 2010s.” 位置为第1章 The Surge of Suffering 章末 “In Sum”,美版精装 p.44。结论:是书内正文,不是宣传材料——官网 anxiousgeneration.com/book 的宣传文案只有小写 “great rewiring of childhood”,并不含此句。
(c) 限定语被压缩掉两处 — 修正前:直接断言式「is the single largest reason」;修正后:原文带作者自限定语 “I argue”(我主张),且带时间窗限定 “that began in the early 2010s”。省略 “I argue” 会把作者的自陈立场读成事实陈述,是实质性口径增强,引用时应补回。

(c) 构念范围 — 修正前:易读作「社交媒体是最大原因」;修正后:句子的主语是 “This Great Rewiring of Childhood”,其定义在紧邻前句,指 2010–2015 年间青少年社交生活整体迁移到智能手机上、并持续接入 social media / online video games / other internet-based activities。即被指认的原因是「手机化童年」这一复合构念,不等同于「社交媒体」单项;且措辞是 “single largest reason”(最大单一原因)而非唯一原因。
(c) 引文中的年份被某些二手源写错 — 修正前/流传变体:summit.org 版本作 “began in the early 2000s”;修正后:正确为 “early 2010s”(wisluthsem.org 引 p.44、stekel.org 整段复现 In Sum 均作 2010s,且与全书论证时间线自洽)。若下游引用取自 summit.org 需改正。

(a) 场合口径 — 修正前:仅称「参议院证词」;修正后:该证词提交于 2022-05-04 参议院司法委员会隐私、技术与法律小组委员会(Subcommittee on Privacy, Technology, and the Law)听证会 “Platform Transparency: Understanding the Impact of Social Media”——听证会主题是平台数据透明度,不是青少年心理健康专场;Haidt 的政策建议主体是 PATA(平台问责与透明法案)、修订 COPPA、年龄验证。另注:Haidt 文件抬头自己把小组委员会名写成 “Subcommittee on Technology, Privacy, and the Law”,与官方名称词序不同(一手文件自身的小瑕疵)。文件标题为 “Teen Mental Health Is Plummeting, and Social Media is a Major Contributing Cause”。

(b) 归属口径 — 修正前:称为「Haidt 官网」;修正后:anxiousgeneration.com 现为 The Anxious Generation(TAG)运动/组织站(页脚 “After Babel © 2026”,FAQ 自述 “TAG was launched in response to the global reaction to Jon's book”),文案是组织文案,不宜逐字归为 Haidt 本人措辞。

(b) 站内存在两个版本的第3条 norm — 修正前:只引「Phone-free schools, from bell to bell」;修正后:首页 “The Four Norms” 主板块确为该逐字表述(与待验表述一致),但同页 FAQ「Our Approach」段落列的是不带 “from bell to bell” 的 “Phone-free schools”。引用时应指明取自 The Four Norms 主板块。
(b) 时间点口径 — 修正前:官网「In 2012, childhood shifted...」被当作与书一致的时间断点;修正后:官网是压缩表述,书内对 Great Rewiring 的时间窗是 “Between 2010 and 2015”。两者不冲突但粒度不同,不可互换引用。
evidence_notes: (a) 逐字核对通过。一手 PDF https://www.judiciary.senate.gov/imo/media/doc/Haidt%20Testimony.pdf 下载后用 pdftotext 提取,第10页原文逐字为:“Correlational, experimental, and eye-witness testimony points to social media as a major cause of the crisis. I do not believe that social media is the only cause of the crisis, but there is no alternative hypothesis that can explain the suddenness, enormity, and international similarity that I laid out in part 1 of this document.” 与待验表述逐字一致(待验表述以 ... 截断于 international similarity)。
(a) 连排版强调也核对通过:用 pypdf 逐 text-run 提取字体,‘only’ 单独一段落在 /ZYVGUU+Calibri-Italic,前后为 /THVBOG+Calibri 正体 —— 即原文确为斜体强调的 *only*,待验表述的 *only* 标记准确。

(a) 文件抬头一手信息:标题 “Teen Mental Health Is Plummeting, and Social Media is a Major Contributing Cause”;“Testimony of Jonathan Haidt, Professor of Ethical Leadership, New York University – Stern School of Business”;“Before the Senate Judiciary Committee, Subcommittee on Technology, Privacy, and the Law”;“May 4, 2022”。证词自述其依据是他与 Jean Twenge 维护的两份 Google Docs 协作综述(tinyurl.com/TeenMentalHealthReview 与 tinyurl.com/SocialMediaMentalHealthReview)—— 即证据基础是作者自建的非同行评议文献汇编,属自我引用型证据链。

(a) 该句紧邻段落还有一段常被略去的论辩性表述:“Researchers and spokespeople for the major platforms who tell you that the evidence is ‘inconclusive’ or that the effect sizes are ‘too small’ should be asked directly: ‘OK, then what do YOU think caused this?’” —— 说明该论断是举证责任转移式论证,而非统计结论。

(b) 逐字核对通过。直接 curl https://www.anxiousgeneration.com/ 原始 HTML(未经摘要模型转述)剥标签后精确命中:“In 2012, childhood shifted from play and independence to screens and social media.”(位于 “The Problem” 段);以及 “The Four Norms to Roll Back the Phone-Based Childhood / 1 No smartphones before high school / 2 No social media before 16 / 3 Phone-free schools, from bell to bell / 4 More independence, free play, and responsibility in the real world”。四条与待验表述逐字一致。
(c) 官网书页 https://www.anxiousgeneration.com/book 原始 HTML 中不含 “single largest reason” / “tidal wave”,只有小写加引号的 “great rewiring of childhood” —— 直接排除「该句仅为宣传文案」的可能性。

(c) 三个相互独立的二手源给出同一逐字句、两个给出同一页码:stekel.org/the-anxious-generation 以 “In Sum” 小标题整段复现第1章章末(含前句 Between 2010 and 2015... 与后句 The first generation of Americans who went through puberty with smartphones...);wisluthsem.org/the-anxious-generation 引 “is the single largest reason for the tidal wave of adolescent mental illness that began in the early 2010s” (44);summit.org 文章引全句(含 “I argue”)并注 “(New York: Penguin Random House, 2024), 44”。以上均以 curl 抓原始 HTML 逐字比对,非摘要转述。

(c) 另有 Kindle 高亮(Goodreads notes,location 7%)逐字复现紧邻前句 “Between 2010 and 2015, the social lives of American teens moved largely onto smartphones with continuous access to social media, online video games, and other internet-based activities.” —— 与上述整段一致,属书内正文的独立佐证。

反证/后续修正检索:官方勘误页 https://www.anxiousgeneration.com/research/errata(Jon Haidt 与 Zach Rausch 署名,2024-06-08 首发,Last published 2026-01-27)列出 6 处事实性错误(p.4 Instagram 40% 口径改为 9–12 岁日活;p.104 18 岁饮酒年龄;p.183 图表把急诊就诊误标为住院;p.232 Snap streaks 可见性;p.236 路易斯安那年龄验证法;p.157-158 “Corpse Bride” 实验实为《华尔街日报》数据团队而非 CCDH)。该页未对 p.44 的 “single largest reason” 论题句作任何修正或撤回 —— 即 (c) 至今未被作者本人更正。

反证:同一勘误页 “2) Postscript” 中 Haidt 主动让步一项核心机制论断:关于 p.128 Brain Drain(手机在场即损害认知)的说法,依据 2024年1月 Technology, Mind, and Behavior 的元分析(33 项研究、166 个效应量、N=4368,d = −0.02,95% CI [−0.06, 0.01],p = .246)承认 “my initial claim... may be incorrect”,并将在下一版修改。这不推翻 (a)(b)(c) 的措辞核对,但表明该书的机制论证已有可核实的实质性退让,引用整体论断时应一并说明。
利益相关性:anxiousgeneration.com 由 TAG 运动运营(页脚 After Babel © 2026),是该书主张的倡导组织,其 “The Problem” 文案属自我论证材料;(a) 证词的证据基础亦为 Haidt/Twenge 自建协作综述。作为「他们说了什么」的来源可靠,作为「该因果结论是否成立」的证据不独立。
